verdict: ROAS holding strong, but purchase volume needs attention this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5.36 for every $1 spent, generating $8,009.23 in revenue from 39 purchases — a solid efficiency floor. That said, purchase volume dropped 50% in the most recent week versus the week prior, and the last three days show near-zero purchase activity, which points to friction in the conversion path rather than an ad performance problem. Attribution tracking is being repaired so that purchase data ties accurately back to each campaign going forward. A funnel test and full tracking setup are being prioritized this week to stabilise the data and protect next period's reads. Expect cleaner attribution numbers and a clearer purchase trend by the next report.
